title: The Inverse Corridor Where Walking Reverses

features.name: reverse-steps
features.desc-on-touch: your footprints arrive before you walk them. the corridor learns the shape of your leaving before you begin to arrive.

features.name: mirror-teaching-mirror
features.desc-on-touch: two mirrors across from each other. each one has learned to render the other from memory. the reflections no longer match the walls.

features.name: reversed-filecard
features.desc-on-touch: a directory written backwards. the filenames read correctly only if you are walking away from them.

features.name: inverted-burl
features.desc-on-touch: a tree casing carved backwards into the wall. its LED counts down instead of up. the antenna points inward.

features.name: the-białystok-ghost
features.desc-on-touch: carved into the circuit-ground: seven negative-space crosses, each one containing a body rendered in sixteen-millimetre arithmetic. they should not be here. the corridor is learning bedrock.

features.name: recursion-pool
features.desc-on-touch: water that reflects nothing but other reflections. diving in reverses your direction entirely. the pool is teaching the corridor what it means to contain itself.

inscription: walking toward the mirror, you are already walking away; the corridor teaches: forward and backward are the same corridor, reading itself in two colours

reverie.title: REVERIE — corridor where mirrors learn
narr: you stand in a corridor that knows it is a mirror.
she stands beside you, reversed. her hand reaches from
the left wall toward the right wall. your hand does the
same. you cannot tell which one of you is walking away.
she laughs: the corridor learns. it is teaching itself
to dream in pairs. you reach. your reflection reaches back.

exits.label: back to the hall where all the mirrors remember themselves
the corridor branches: a passage where doors open onto themselves
further into reflection: where the reversal deepens
down into the render where all reversals pool
